purpose: Phase-5D PROTEIN registry. Protein identities, turnover, per-protein evidence records (with verification_status), and prediction records for the translation outputs. Consumed READ-ONLY. Protein CATALYTIC / downstream FUNCTION is NOT implemented in this phase (functional_state stays not_evaluated). No protein copy number, half-life, fold change, or degradation constant is fabricated; unavailable values are NOT_REPORTED.
evidence_decision_note: Although the general literature reports celastrol-induced HO-1/HMOX1 protein in HaCaT keratinocytes, the FROZEN Profile-B evidence package (Chen 2012) contains NO HaCaT HO-1 protein measurement, and no primary HO-1/NQO1/inflammatory-protein source is verified IN THIS REPOSITORY. Per the project rule 'do not mark protein production experimental without a verified primary source in the same context present in the evidence registry', HO-1 protein is classified LITERATURE_DERIVED_PREDICTION (not EXPERIMENTAL_DRUG_CELL_SPECIFIC). It may be upgraded to EXPERIMENTAL_DRUG_CELL_SPECIFIC ONLY when such a primary source is attached + verified here.

turnover.degradation_class_basis: SCHEMATIC (generic simulation behaviour); biological half-life NOT_REPORTED

prot_ho1.rationale: Celastrol-induced HO-1 protein is described in the literature for keratinocytes, but is NOT in the frozen Profile-B package and no primary source is verified in this repo -> labelled prediction, not experimental.

prot_nqo1.rationale: NQO1 is a canonical Nrf2/ARE target; its translation into protein is a mechanistic prediction from the 5C transcription chain. No same-context primary protein evidence is verified here.

prot_infl.rationale: Schematic NF-kB target protein. Its mRNA is suppressed (5C) -> reduced translation input -> lower schematic mature protein abundance. NOT named ICAM1: no verified ICAM1 primary evidence is present in this repo, so a schematic identity is used. Adhesion / inflammation phenotype is NOT modelled.
